ev_0006.summary: Figure: a horizontal segment PQ (P(49,349) to Q(470,349)) with collinear points A(142,349), D(187,349), E(377,349) in order P,A,D,E,Q. A vertical segment AB runs from A(142,349) up to B(142,157), perpendicular to PQ, with a right-angle mark at A. Apex C(236,64) connects to B (segment BC, supervisor-verified, not returned by CV line detection), to D (segment CD, falls to D at 187,349), and to E (segment CE). Labels P, A, D, E, Q, B, C are supervisor-verified and match CV label bindings. No circles or arcs are included: the detect_circles results are spurious.

payload.notes: Used STYLE METRICS scale s=0.017978 cm/px with A as origin and y flipped. Line width 1.4pt, round joins, and 14pt labels (16.8 leading) per the metrics block. Labels below the line for P, A, D, E, Q; B left; C above. Right-angle mark at A is a single 0.31 cm square drawn once, inside the angle toward D and B. No circles or arcs. Only standard TikZ, no libraries.
